body: MAINLINE-005 filed. All nine rows (P1, P1-A, P2, P2-A, P2-C, P2-K, P2-E, P3, P3-A) give the SF-1 modulus and compressive strength at present mass and geometry, the equal-mass figure each limit constrains with 6061-T6 beside it, and the pair meeting both modes at once. Buckling requirements scale as 1/kd for MAINLINE-004. Every row is below SF 1 in both modes on 6061-T6; the film passes at SF 2.51. Limits were recomputed from formula and match the pinned 002/003 RESULTS; 12 of 12 pins verified. This feeds MAINLINE-008. Starting NFI-CRUSH now as MAINLINE-005b, no ruling needed.
